title: Blue Light Illumination Effects on bPACy and WT Organisms
summary: This cluster describes the effects of blue light illumination on two organisms, bPACy and wild-type (WT). The organisms were exposed to blue light or darkness, and their metabolome and proteome were analyzed. The bPACy organism has a higher abundance of AMP and a lower adenylate energy charge compared to WT. The metabolome of both organisms was affected by the blue light illumination, with β-carotene and Cordycepin levels increasing in response to cAMP regulation. The proteome of bPACy was also affected, with protein kinase A and adenylate cyclase being regulated by cAMP. The cluster highlights the differences in response to blue light illumination between the two organisms.
